Description: EBS snapshots found without secure encryption at rest enabled.
Risk: Unencrypted EBS snapshots expose sensitive data, system configurations, and applications to unauthorized access if the snapshot is accidentally shared, copied, or exposed.

Recommendation.Text: Consider enabling EBS Encryption by Default at the account level to ensure all future volumes and snapshots are automatically encrypted. For existing unencrypted snapshots, create a copy of the snapshot and enable encryption during the copy process.
